summary: Comprehensive architectural and product implementation plan for Rakthapariksha.com (రక్త పరీక్ష.కామ్), covering multi-lab price comparison across 5 NABL/CAP accredited partners, zero-login instant access, single-screen booking with live GPS & UPI QR, WebSocket-backed real-time order tracking, AES-256 patient health data encryption with PII masking, Gemini AI prescription scanner & bilingual medical advisor, voice search, family biomarker trends, and the RP2026 admin dispatch portal.
